scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run --cwd packages/cli dev -- ../../README.md
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/server build
scripts.install:global: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/server build && sh -c 'npm install -g ./packages/cli ./packages/server || npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" ./packages/cli ./packages/server'
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build && bun run install:global
